question.text:
Product (X and Y) of the following reactions (1 and 2) are

(1) 2NaOH(Cold and dilute)+Cl2→NaCl+X+H2O

(2) 6NaOH(Hot and conc.)+3Cl2→NaCl+Y+3H2O
